title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Hall on 1972-11-13
lineage: 1st generation cassettes (Harmon Kardon TD392) > DAT Sony 59ES)(16/48kHz); DAT 16/48kHz (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (.wav 16/48kHz) > Adobe Audition 2022 > TLH 1648
source: Karl Ryan's Master Audience Reels (unknown mics/deck); Tim Welch's 1st generation cassettes > DAT (16/48kHz)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording featuring a blissful, 72‑minute Dark Star>Dew jam
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the audio quality, calling the tape an "improved gem" and urging listeners to crank it up. The performance is highlighted by a soaring 72‑minute Dark Star into Dew sequence that lives up to its name.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic 5‑star review; both show and recording are praised, leading to a high composite rating but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer explicitly loves the AUD (audio) quality, describing it as an "improved gem" with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A massive 72‑minute fall creates a powerful, uplifting jam that dominates the show’s momentum.
